services.expo.agitator_intro: From rigorous feasibility analysis to turnkey construction, we deliver custom bioenergy systems with zero operational downtime.
services.expo.agitator_body1: Our advanced vertical and horizontal agitation technologies eliminate dead zones and prevent foam formation. This ensures excellent substrate homogeneity, delivering maximum methane conversion and higher energy efficiency.
services.expo.agitator_body2: With Iona's proprietary mixing technology and robust direct solids feeding systems, our plants maintain highly stable operation even at dry matter content of up to 14% within the anaerobic digester.
services.expo.genset_intro: We build turnkey biogas plants that deliver efficient, sustainable energy solutions.
services.expo.genset_body1: Our innovative Overflow Transfer System (OFT) operates entirely on the "connected vessels" principle. By intelligently harnessing gravity for digestate transfer, it greatly reduces mechanical stress and cuts pumping energy consumption by up to 66%.
services.expo.genset_body2: Smart heat distribution units optimize thermal energy usage. Every Iona plant includes automatic thermal freeze protection integrated with smart sensors.
services.expo.pump_intro: Our Central Pump Station (CPS) delivers pulsation-free, stable flow to every point in the plant, even at high solids ratios.
services.expo.pump_body1: The eccentric rotor turns within an elastomer stator to produce a pulsation-free, constant flow rate. This extends pump service life and reduces maintenance frequency, even with abrasive, high-viscosity substrates.
services.expo.pump_body2: Thanks to the modular housing design, the stator — the only wearing component — can be replaced in minutes without dismantling the entire line, engineered for zero downtime outside of scheduled maintenance.

services.workflow.title: Project Development Stages
services.workflow.step1_desc: We assess your organic waste potential, analyze local substrate availability, and precisely calculate the return on investment for your future biogas plant.
services.workflow.step2_desc: Our engineering team designs anaerobic digestion systems optimized specifically for your waste type, ensuring maximum operational efficiency and structural durability.

services.faq.title: Common Technical Questions
services.faq.q1: How do Iona mixing systems maximize biogas yield?
services.faq.a1: Our advanced vertical and horizontal agitation technologies eliminate dead zones and prevent foam formation. This ensures excellent substrate homogeneity, delivering maximum methane conversion and higher energy efficiency.
services.faq.q2: Can your systems handle high dry matter content?
services.faq.a2: Yes. With Iona's proprietary mixing technology and robust direct solids feeding systems, our plants maintain highly stable operation even at dry matter content of up to 14% within the anaerobic digester.
services.faq.q3: How does the zero-energy overflow system work?
services.faq.a3: Our innovative Overflow Transfer System (OFT) operates entirely on the "connected vessels" principle. By intelligently harnessing gravity for digestate transfer, it greatly reduces mechanical stress and cuts pumping energy consumption by up to 66%.
services.faq.q4: What protects pipelines from freezing in winter?
services.faq.a4: Every Iona plant includes automatic thermal Freeze Protection integrated with smart sensors. The system automatically detects sub-zero ambient temperatures and activates line heating to prevent freezing and avoid costly downtime.
industries.hero.title: The Industries We Serve and Our Global Network
industries.hero.body: From municipalities to heavy industry, and from agriculture to livestock farming, we deliver turnkey biogas solutions across diverse sectors, bringing every project to life through our global supply and engineering network.
industries.list.title: Industries We Serve
industries.list.item1_subtitle: Municipal Solid Waste Processing · Clean Local Energy Generation
industries.list.item1_desc: We partner with municipalities to convert urban organic waste into uninterrupted green energy. Our advanced bio-digestion technology reduces landfill dependency and cleanly empowers local communities.
industries.list.item2_subtitle: Food Industry Waste Treatment · Eco-Friendly Wastewater Disposal
industries.list.item2_desc: We deliver high-capacity biogas systems custom-designed for industrial organic wastewater and factory food waste. Our plants significantly reduce disposal costs while generating green electricity and heat on-site.
industries.list.item3_subtitle: Organic Biomass Conversion · High-Efficiency Methane Production
industries.list.item3_desc: We convert agricultural residues and crop waste into clean, sustainable energy. Our engineering solutions maximize methane output while providing high-quality organic fertilizers for eco-friendly farming.
industries.list.item4_subtitle: Eco-Friendly Manure Stabilization · Odor Emission Elimination
industries.list.item4_desc: We help large-scale farms efficiently manage animal manure through advanced anaerobic digestion. Our biogas plants eliminate harmful greenhouse gases, remove odor, and generate profitable green energy.
industries.partners.title: Our Technology and Supply Partners
industries.partners.body: Every plant is built on our network of specialized global suppliers and engineering partners. Six core areas of collaboration make a turnkey biogas project possible:
industries.partners.item1_desc: We work with global equipment manufacturers specializing in high-efficiency cogeneration engines and gas genset systems.
industries.partners.item2_desc: We develop integrated solutions with industrial automation technology providers for remote monitoring, process control, and 24/7 plant management.
industries.partners.item3_desc: We collaborate with specialized engineering equipment suppliers for central pump stations and gas valve chambers.
industries.partners.item4_desc: We work with expert material suppliers for digester covers, gas storage, and sealing systems.
industries.partners.item5_desc: We build project partnerships with international engineering and consulting firms for feasibility studies and environmental impact assessments.
industries.partners.item6_desc: We work together with global investment and project finance institutions to bring projects to life.

flux.hero.title: One Plant, One Screen, Total Control.
flux.hero.body: IonaFlux is a digital operations platform developed by Iona's engineering team and delivered to our customers. It brings live plant data, fault management and field operations together in one panel.
flux.live.title: Every Reading From Your Plant, on Screen in Real Time.
flux.live.body: PLC data refreshes every five seconds; nothing is simulated. Every digester's temperature, flow rate and alarm state is monitored in real time. An alarm raised overnight is reported to the on-call engineer automatically.
flux.catalog.title: End-to-End Management, From the Field to the Office.
flux.catalog.item1_desc: Daily field reports, flow reports and analysis reports are generated as branded PDFs in one click and shared directly with the customer.
flux.catalog.item2_desc: Field staff report a fault instantly; the request is auto-assigned to the relevant engineer and tracked through open, assigned, in progress and resolved.
flux.catalog.item3_desc: Shift planning, task assignment, checklists, weighbridge and logistics, feedstock recipes: every daily field operation is managed in one application.
flux.qr.title: Identify the Machine, Shorten the Downtime.
flux.qr.body: Every piece of equipment carries a QR code. Once scanned with a phone, that machine's live status, serial number and wiring diagram are displayed instantly.
flux.lab.title: See the Cause of a Yield Change Instantly.
flux.lab.body: Lab results are compared against the nominal range; the yield score shows the weekly change and recommends the necessary action.
flux.fleet.title: Plants Managed From One Panel, Kept Isolated From Each Other.
flux.fleet.body: Every plant in your portfolio operates under its own access key, and data is never shared across plants. As your portfolio grows, you continue managing it from a single panel.
flux.video.title: Watch IonaFlux in Two Minutes.
flux.video.body: A short walkthrough with real screens, showing the app exactly as it's delivered to our customers.
